decision_cruda.rationale: LH-06 is down at TJ-C564-01. The radio and OT-5100 agree on this, so CONFIRM-01 does not apply. The repair is estimated at 1 to 2 h, likely 1.5 h, so it should end around 11:30, with a worst case of 12:00. The stope is low grade (5.8 g/t) and has about 216 t of broken ore left. The only candidate lender is LH-10, which is in preventive maintenance and not available before 11:00 (PM-01). It could not start loading before about 11:30 because of the 11:00-11:30 break and about 0.3 h of travel. That is roughly when LH-06 is likely back. A loan would add only 0 to 0.5 h of loading, about 12 t or 2 oz at best, and less once LH-10 is moved back. Central's level stockpile is already at 298 of 450 t and the mine is truck-limited, so the extra ore would gain little. Other loaders could only be taken from producing places, which loses more than it gains. There are no stopped stopes that free a loader, so no reserve is activated. The best decision is to move nothing.
